classification_rationale: The user-supplied audit supplies no independently replicated demonstration of a usable net-energy-harvesting technology. Casimir-effect physics is real (predicted by Casimir, Proc. Kon. Ned. Akad. Wet. 51, 793 (1948); measured to about one percent at the smallest separation by Mohideen-Roy, Phys. Rev. Lett. 81, 4549 (1998)) but, within the sources directly inspected for this correction (enumerated in provenance), does not by itself demonstrate a cyclic net-work source (Jaffe, Phys. Rev. D 72, 021301 (2005) states that Casimir forces can be computed without reference to zero point energies; the further step - that the measured force does not by itself establish a zero-point-energy reservoir - is this record's own bounded inference, not Jaffe's statement); idealised vacuum-work proposals are admitted here only behind careful full-cycle energy accounting, a repository requirement rather than a literature finding. The F classification here is an evidence and engineering disposition for this repository, not a declaration that every idealised vacuum-work proposal is mathematically forbidden.
legitimate_uses: A research-ledger record documenting why the harvesting claim is classified F, preserving the idea without endorsing it
minimal_evidence_before_implementation: Primary-source review and independent replicated evidence of a usable net-energy-harvesting technology, justifying a later separately audited reclassification
